name: noetis-compute
description: Noetis Compute — federated decentralized AI compute network prototype

scripts.build: npm run build -w @noetis/protocol && npm run build -w @noetis/crypto && npm run build -w @noetis/currency && npm run build -w @noetis/blockchain && npm run build -w @noetis/p2p && npm run build -w @noetis/scheduler && npm run build -w @noetis/ollama-client && npm run build -w @noetis/database && npm run build -w @noetis/full-node && npm run build -w @noetis/api && npm run build -w @noetis/coordinator && npm run build -w @noetis/validator && npm run build -w @noetis/node && npm run build -w @noetis/web
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d postgres redis && concurrently -n api,coord,val,web "npm run dev -w @noetis/api" "npm run dev -w @noetis/coordinator" "npm run dev -w @noetis/validator" "npm run dev -w @noetis/web"
